summary: The earlier manual-borrow utility thesis gained market and TVL confirmation as HYPE printed a new all-time high above $90 and Hyperliquid L1 TVL expanded sharply, but leverage crowding simultaneously increased and no clean new external-capital or selective-wallet confirmation appeared. HOLD / NO ADD.

ecosystem_regime_evidence.interpretation: TVL confirmation is strong, but negative weekly stablecoin flow and declining weekly spot DEX activity mean this is not yet a clean broad external-capital migration signal. RWA remains immaterial to the thesis.

product_catalyst.attribution_caveat: The reported $269M figure covers the shared manual-borrow / portfolio-margin infrastructure and is not cleanly attributable to new manual-borrow demand.

market_confirmation.interpretation: The product launch has received genuine market confirmation, but a portion of the move is now leverage-sensitive and should not be treated as independent fundamental confirmation.

derivatives_risk.interpretation: OI expanded materially into the breakout and the freshest observed funding snapshot accelerated to roughly 59.1% annualized. This materially worsens crowding and two-sided liquidation reflexivity, especially now that HYPE can itself support borrowing collateral.

wallet_quality.note: Previously observed large accumulators remain supportive but are not recycled as new confirmation; no newly funded, historically selective independent HYPE cohort was verified in this run.

value_capture.note: Manual borrowing improves utility/composability, but it is not itself direct HYPE-holder revenue. Existing protocol fee/buyback and AQAv2 mechanisms remain the direct value-capture legs.

caveats: low circulating value relative to FDV / future dilution
rising derivatives open interest and sharply positive funding
manual-borrow versus portfolio-margin utilization is not cleanly decomposed

paper_portfolio_action.reason: HYPE remains only about 2.7% of paper NAV, so sizing capacity exists. The no-add decision is driven by leverage crowding, absent fresh selective-wallet confirmation, and lack of clean stablecoin/spot-flow acceleration rather than by portfolio limits.

next_confirmation_triggers: clean split of manual-borrow demand versus existing portfolio-margin borrowing
HYPE share of posted collateral and borrowing utilization remaining elevated after launch novelty
renewed positive stablecoin inflows plus persistent spot/fee growth
derivatives OI/funding normalizing while price/usage persists
new genuinely independent historically selective HYPE accumulator cohort
first verifiable AQAv2 settlement on or after 2026-10-03
risk_triggers: rising OI/funding concurrent with stablecoin outflows and weak spot demand
